clauses.feature_definition: Use all cells, with stored cell values directly and arithmetic means of vertex values for point fields.
clauses.property_measure: Compute the stated properties of the selected object.
clauses.aggregation_or_representation: Weight cell statistics by cell volume and normalize by the included volume.
clauses.criterion: Select cells at or above the volume-weighted 90th percentile of the stated field; use the left inverse of the cumulative volume distribution and retain all ties.
